digest.component_or_area: DC harness and inbound field reconciliation
propositions: Live DC harness must validate rendered HTML output via ?expand=renderedFields API query to verify Jira's actual interpretation of wiki markup (bold, heading, code macros), not just the stored wiki source
A second reconcile pass against live Jira instance must demonstrate state-based echo-safety: a pushed rich body decodes to a value the differ recognizes as unchanged, triggering no re-push

With a converged baseline, a concurrent both-sides edit (rebar-side AND Jira-side to the same description field before next pass) must emit rebar's body (local-wins) and record a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert without silently destroying the remote value
InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must be guarded by a cross-repo contract test that pins its public shape and behavior to prevent breaking changes in agentic-dev-platform imports
Live test must reuse existing Docker harness fixtures, skip markers, and session-scoped PAT provisioning without introducing new CI jobs
